introduced.event_name: NCC June 1982 — colour graphics and mouse interaction

specification.status: Accepted protocol requirements; wire identifiers, polling and electrical qualification pending.
specification.discovery: Pointing-device class, two buttons, relative X/Y, two independent signed roller axes; versioned capability record. Use negotiated existing FlexiBUS rates, framing, CRC and request/response discipline.
specification.report: Sequenced bounded report: accumulated signed relative X/Y motion, signed vertical/horizontal roller deltas, current button mask and ordered button transitions. ACK/retry must not duplicate motion or clicks.
specification.polling: Host polls with a bounded service budget; device buffers events. Coalesce motion but preserve button transitions; report overflow and resynchronize button state on reset/removal.
specification.default_mapping: Primary button focuses/selects/activates; secondary opens context actions where provided. Middle-finger roller scrolls vertically; thumb roller scrolls horizontally. Wheels have no implicit press buttons.
specification.compatibility: Architecture-neutral class driver for Z80 CP/M Platform Extensions and ERA AIONix. Attach while port quiescent; no unsupported hot-plug claim.
